name: session-orchestrator
description: Turns the main session into an orchestrator: detects the harness and its per-call model/effort support, splits a task into session-local roles with self-contained briefs, routes each role to a model alias and effort level by task class, delegates to a leaf-only role-runner agent, gates file-writing roles behind user approval, keeps parallel writers on disjoint files, then verifies, reports and cleans up a gitignored temp folder. Falls back to model-only, same-model or inline roles.
